cuts.title: Jerma tries to fuel a bike in GTA RP and it explodes
cuts.hook: Jerma tries to fuel a bike
cuts.retelling: Jerma tries to fuel a bike at a GTA RP pump while calling for Donnie, the bike bursts into flames, and Pokelawls's stream shows the same fire burning his own bike.

cuts.title: CaseOh promises a 100% survival rate
cuts.retelling: A checkpoint doctor (CaseOh) tells a sick survivor the lab trip is minimally invasive with a 100% survival rate, then harvests his organs and ribs and the man ends up dead on the lab floor.

cuts.label: joebartolozzi@vod2894517660/joebartolozzi-charact-cutscene-2026w41
cuts.title: Joe Bartolozzi begs his editor to blur this GTA scene
cuts.hook: Joe begs his editor to blur GTA
cuts.retelling: Joe is stunned that two GTA characters keep chatting through an awkward scene, begs his editor to blur it, then panics about eye contact when the game cuts back to his character and decides he has to run.

cuts.title: Pokimane Left Stream And Came Back With Chicken From Two Places
cuts.hook: Pokimane left mid-stream and came back
cuts.retelling: Pokimane leaves her chair mid-stream and comes back with fried chicken from two different places, joking that it's the greed the Bible talks about.

cuts.title: Cinna's getaway was 'so cool' until they started looking for her
cuts.retelling: Cinna and a friend pull off a slick getaway in a No Pixel truck, then hear people searching right outside their hiding spot and decide to stay put in the car.

cuts.title: Pokimane planned to call Kai before opening her box
cuts.hook: Pokimane will call Kai before opening this
cuts.retelling: Pokimane says she'll call Kai Cenat before opening her PR box, can't choose between his two numbers, decides not to bother him, then opens the box and finds her name misspelled as 'Pokemon'.

cuts.label: northernlion@momentseductivecoldbloodedbunnydoggo-nu_sejvz1len42ke/northernlion-about-card-2026w42
cuts.title: The heaven joke that broke the lobby
cuts.retelling: Northernlion wonders whether you stay in your dying body's condition in heaven, reads a dark Jackbox card that the question inspired, and the table then debates which age you'd be, landing on Jesus's age of 33.
